summary.text: Blake Sanders is a Republican state representative from Anderson County who has represented South Carolina House District 9 since 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A landscape architect and former mayor of West Pelzer, he faces Democrat Johnny Estrich in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Blake Sanders was born on July 27, 1982, in Greenville and graduated from Clemson University in 2006 with a B.S., according to the House member page.
He served on the West Pelzer Town Council from 2011 to 2015 and as mayor of the town from 2015 to 2023.

In a Ballotpedia survey in 2024, Sanders described himself as a landscape architect, planner and president of Studio Main, a former lecturer at Clemson University and a lifelong resident of District 9.
He said that his work as a planner and his eight years as mayor shaped his priorities, and that he was passionate about collaborative public policy, specifically planning, conservation and finance.
The House member page lists his committee assignments as Government Efficiency and Legislative Oversight, and Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs.
